name: Intercom
one_liner: Customer messaging and support platform with a REST API for conversations, contacts and help center.
auth_notes: Private apps use an Access Token sent as an Authorization Bearer header. Public apps must use OAuth. The pages do not name the OAuth flow type.
access_notes: An Access Token is issued as soon as an app is created in the Developer Hub. Cost and plan gating are not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Private apps get self-serve Access Tokens from the Developer Hub, but public apps must implement OAuth. Plan or cost gating is not on the fetched pages. The MCP server does not support AU workspaces.

identity.quote: Find and retrieve Intercom data (conversations, contacts, etc.)

auth.quote: Once you have a token, whether an access token or a token via the OAuth process, simply provide it as an Authorization:Bearer header in your requests

access.quote: We provide you with an Access Token as soon as you create an app on your workspace.

api_surface.quote: This is documentation for version 2.9 of the REST API.

mcp.quote: Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that follows the authenticated remote MCP specification

buildability.quote: apps are required to use OAuth rather than asking users for Access Tokens.

needs_human_reason: Plan or cost gating, sandbox availability, endpoint breadth and REST rate limits are not on the fetched pages.
